gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 1538.—It is hereby notified that the following thoroughfares will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Road about 40 yards to the south of Ma Tau Kok Road and parallel to it, commencing at its junction with Pau Chung Street and running in a north-westerly direction for about 100 yards as shewn coloured red on plan No. R.K. 522. Proposed Name: WANG CHEUNG STREET. Chinese Version: 宏昌街.
